title: Fix Ruffle player loading: script URL never resolves, wasm assets missing from build
description: Test Movie shows a black window: new URL("@ruffle-rs/ruffle/ruffle.js", import.meta.url) in packages/player/src/RufflePlayer.tsx:58-80 uses a bare specifier Vite does not rewrite — 404 in dev and prod, ensureRuffle rejects, createAndLoad fails silently. Also ruffle.js sibling assets (core.ruffle.*.js chunks + .wasm) are never copied into the build output. Fix resolution (import the package properly or vite asset handling), ship the wasm/chunks, and surface load errors to the user instead of console.error. See docs/16-player-runtime.md.
